scholarships.title: Chula LINK Scholarship 2026
scholarships.official_source: Chulalongkorn University (Office of International Affairs and Global Network)

eligibility: Must be an international student who does not hold a Thai passport
Must be admitted to or currently studying in the first semester at Chulalongkorn University
Must be enrolled in a Master's or a doctoral degree programme
existing.eligibility_summary: International students who do not hold a Thai passport, admitted to or currently studying in the first semester at Chulalongkorn University, enrolled in a Master's or doctoral degree programme.
requirements: Be an international student who does not hold a Thai passport
Be admitted to or currently studying in the first semester at Chulalongkorn University
Be enrolled in a Master's or doctoral degree programme
Submit the application through the published Google Forms link before the deadline
documents: The Chula LINK Scholarship application submitted through the published Google Forms link (https://forms.gle/gU5oe1FgwqZZLXNn9)
The university's published timeline document for the 2026 award, distributed by the Office of International Affairs and Global Network
application_method: Complete and submit the Chula LINK Scholarship application through the Google Forms link published on the Office of International Affairs and Global Network funding-opportunity page
For any queries contact int.off@chula.ac.th or call +66 2 218 3101 extension 8335
existing.selection_notes: The published call does not state selection criteria, an award quota or a weighting. The funding opportunity page records the status as Open, the funding type as Scholarship, the eligible applicants as International Students and the supporting body as Chulalongkorn University. The university also publishes a timeline document for the award as a PDF.
existing.best_fit: International (non-Thai passport) Master's and doctoral students at Chulalongkorn University who need tuition, living costs and airfare support for the second semester of academic year 2026.
existing.notes: The call page lists the benefit components but does not publish the monetary value of the tuition coverage, the monthly living allowance or the airfare; those amounts are in the university's timeline document, which is published as a PDF. The application itself is collected through a Google Forms link, which is the route the university publishes.
existing.duration: Awarded for the second semester of academic year 2026 as published; the call page does not state a longer award period
existing.application_period: Open now: the Office of International Affairs and Global Network publishes "Application: Now - 31 October 2026" for the Chula LINK Scholarship for the second semester of academic year 2026. A detailed timeline is published by the university as a separate PDF (Chula-Link-Scholarship-2026-Timeline.pdf).
